candidates.label: Funding Line
candidates.description: An appropriation of money with its own authorization ceiling, the portion of it placed under obligation, and the portion actually expended. Questions about how much money is left to obligate, whether authorization covers what has been committed, or where the effort will run out of money before it runs out of work target this class. Its three quantities are a LADDER - each is a subset of the one above it - which is what distinguishes it from a requirement compared against a supply.

candidates.label: Performance Measurement Baseline
candidates.description: The time-phased plan against which performance is measured: budgeted cost for work scheduled spread over periods, together with the claimed and actual figures reported against it period by period. IT CARRIES THE ACTUAL COST INCURRED IN EACH PERIOD, so the rate at which cost is being incurred - how fast money is going out, and whether that is faster or slower than the plan phased for it - is a property of this class. Questions about the planned spread of budget over time, about how much was planned versus claimed versus paid in a period, about the pace of expenditure against plan, or about how the phasing has shifted target this class. What is measured here is COST INCURRED AGAINST A PHASED PLAN, which is a different thing from the headroom remaining in an appropriation: this compares spending to a schedule, not a drawn amount to an authorized ceiling. It is the SERIES, not a single figure - anything asked over time or by month means this.

candidates.label: Control Account
candidates.description: The management point where scope, schedule and budget meet a single accountable manager, and the level at which performance is formally measured and reported. Questions naming an account identifier and asking how it is performing, who owns the number, or where a reported variance was incurred target this class. It is the lowest level at which a manager is answerable for a number.

candidates.label: Program
candidates.description: The whole scope of effort under one contract or one authorization, measured as a single performance whole. Questions asking how the effort as a whole is performing, how much of the authorized money remains, what the total forecast at completion is, or where the effort stands against its time-phased plan target this class. It is the widest finance subject: an answer scoped to it rolls up everything reported beneath it.
